notes: Eclipse Loop 1.4.0 - comping arrives. NEW: COMPING (loop-record takes) - the flagship feature. In ARRANGE, drag the top half of the ruler to set a loop region, arm REC MIDI and play: every pass over the loop is captured as its own TAKE stacked on the clip. Comped clips show a pip row + "T2/3" badge (active take / total); right-click the clip - Takes to audition and keep the best pass. Loop a section, play it a few times, comp the keeper. NEW: Eclipse Vibe on-screen keyboard - a KEYS toggle reveals a melodic keyboard (C1..C5) that plays the SELECTED drum at pitch, so the 808 (and toms/rim) play melodically - sliding 808 basslines with GLIDE. NEW: What's New ticker - a live release-notes banner scrolls next to PRESET in the top toolbar. Still 4 synths (Prism, Alloy, Dusk, Vibe) + 25 FX bundled, universal (Apple Silicon + Intel), macOS 12+.
